generator.section_1_body: Choose from six signature wedding illustration styles — botanical watercolor, minimal line art, vintage engraving, Italian romance, coastal, or classic luxury. Each one has its own hand-drawn aesthetic and matches a curated set of layouts.
generator.section_2_body: Add flowers, personal touches, a border, and a location to make the crest feel like yours. AI integrates every selected element into one cohesive image.

monogram.meta_description: Create a custom wedding monogram with intertwined initials and editorial typography. Six styles, eight typography pairings.
monogram.heading: Wedding monogram maker
monogram.intro: A wedding monogram is the simplest mark of your day. Choose how your initials appear, then AI renders them together with the illustrated crest as one complete image.
monogram.section_1_body: Enter both partners names and choose an initials or name display. AI renders the exact lettering as part of the complete crest artwork.
monogram.section_2_body: The same six signature styles work for monograms. A minimal line art monogram is the most contemporary; a vintage engraving monogram is the most formal.
monogram.section_3_body: Eight typography directions give your monogram a distinct voice. Each change is re-rendered by AI inside the finished image.
monogram.section_4_body: Unlock the Wedding Image Pack to download your selected AI-generated crest and every completed variation at source quality.
monogram.faq_1_a: A monogram is a typographic mark of intertwined initials. It's traditionally used on invitations, signage, napkins, and favors — wherever you want a clean, recognizable mark of the couple.
monogram.faq_2_q: Can I use just one initial?
monogram.faq_2_a: Yes. The name display can be initials only, full first names, or a surname — whichever fits your wedding's tone.
monogram.faq_3_q: What's the difference between a monogram and a crest?
monogram.faq_3_a: A monogram focuses on initials. A crest combines the initials or names with illustrated motifs; AI renders both together in the final image.

botanical-watercolor.meta_description: Soft watercolor botanicals, garden blooms, and editorial typography. Compose a botanical watercolor wedding crest in minutes.
botanical-watercolor.heading: Botanical watercolor wedding crests
botanical-watercolor.intro: Soft watercolor botanicals, loose olive branches, and trailing garden blooms. The botanical watercolor style is the most loved for garden, vineyard, and estate weddings.
botanical-watercolor.section_1_body: A watercolor illustration feels hand-painted, even when it isn't. It softens the typography and gives the crest a romantic, lived-in quality that prints beautifully on cotton paper.
botanical-watercolor.section_2_body: Editorial rose typography, sage and ivory palettes, and venues like villas, gardens, vineyards, and countryside estates. Add white roses, peonies, or olive branches for a true botanical feel.
botanical-watercolor.section_3_body: The botanical oval and trailing garland layouts were designed for this style. They give the watercolor room to breathe around the monogram.
botanical-watercolor.section_4_body: Save the dates with deckled edges, invitations on cotton paper, menus with watercolor floral corners, and welcome signs framed in olive wood.
botanical-watercolor.faq_1_a: White roses, peonies, olive branches, eucalyptus, and trailing jasmine all work. Pick one to three — the program will not over-clutter the crest.
botanical-watercolor.faq_2_q: Is it too soft for a formal wedding?
botanical-watercolor.faq_2_a: Not at all. Pair it with classic caps or modern serif typography, and the result feels editorial and formal — just softer than engraving.
botanical-watercolor.faq_3_q: Can I print it at any size?
botanical-watercolor.faq_3_a: Yes. Unlock the Wedding Image Pack to download the original source-quality AI image without the preview watermark.

minimal-line-art.meta_description: Fine single-line illustrations, modern layouts, and minimal typography. Compose a minimal line art wedding crest.
minimal-line-art.heading: Minimal line art wedding crests
minimal-line-art.intro: A single, confident line. Minimal line art crests feel modern and clean — perfect for a city loft, a contemporary venue, or a couple who wants something quietly elegant.
minimal-line-art.section_1_body: One continuous line. No fills, no fuss. The result feels hand-drawn but reads as modern — a single olive branch, a contour of a face, a continuous mountain range.
minimal-line-art.section_2_body: Minimal sans typography, black-and-ivory or sage palettes, and venues like lofts, museums, restaurants, and contemporary hotels. Less is more here — pick one personal touch, not two.
minimal-line-art.section_3_body: The arch and single-line layouts give the illustration room to be the star. The monogram sits quietly inside the line.
minimal-line-art.section_4_body: Letterpress invitations on cotton paper, deckled menus, foil-stamped signage, and clean save the dates. This style also prints beautifully in black and white.
minimal-line-art.faq_1_a: No — the line is carefully composed to feel balanced. The empty space is part of the design, not a lack of detail.
minimal-line-art.faq_2_a: A single line of your venue, your pet's silhouette, or a monogram inside the line. Keep it to one touch for the cleanest result.
minimal-line-art.faq_3_q: Can I print it in black and white?
minimal-line-art.faq_3_a: Yes. Unlock the Wedding Image Pack to download the original source-quality AI image without the preview watermark.

vintage-engraving.meta_description: Classical engraving, heraldic detail, and timeless typography. Compose a vintage engraving wedding crest.
vintage-engraving.heading: Vintage engraving wedding crests
vintage-engraving.intro: Classical engraving — the kind you find in old books and family crests. The vintage engraving style is the most formal, the most timeless, and the most loved for historic venues.
vintage-engraving.section_1_body: Engraving is the original wedding crest. It carries history — a coat of arms, a family heirloom, a letterpress invitation. Modern engraving feels like a found object from a beautiful library.
vintage-engraving.section_2_body: Vintage engraving typography, burgundy and navy palettes, and venues like castles, manor houses, libraries, and historic hotels. Add a single personal touch — a family crest or a meaningful date.
vintage-engraving.section_3_body: The shield and crest layouts were designed for this style. They give the engraving the weight of a true coat of arms.
vintage-engraving.section_4_body: Letterpress invitations on cotton paper, gold foil details, wax seals, and formal menus. This style is the most formal option in the studio.
vintage-engraving.faq_1_a: Not at all. Modern engraving can be light and romantic — pair it with a romantic script typography for a softer feel.
vintage-engraving.faq_2_a: A family crest, a single meaningful object, or a hand-drawn monogram. Avoid clutter — engraving rewards restraint.
vintage-engraving.faq_3_q: Can I print it in gold foil?
vintage-engraving.faq_3_a: Yes. Unlock the Wedding Image Pack to download the original source-quality AI image without the preview watermark.

italian-romance.meta_description: Trailing lemon blossoms, villa romance, and editorial typography. Compose an Italian romance wedding crest.
italian-romance.heading: Italian romance wedding crests
italian-romance.intro: Trailing lemon blossoms, terracotta tiles, and an afternoon in Tuscany. The Italian romance style is the most cinematic — the one for a wedding abroad, a villa, a long table under the wisteria.
italian-romance.section_1_body: Italian romance is a feeling, not a place. It's trailing lemon blossoms, an old stone villa, a long table. The illustration carries the warmth of the setting.
italian-romance.section_2_body: Romantic script or editorial italic typography, blush rose and olive palettes, and venues like Tuscan villas, Lake Como estates, and Amalfi gardens. Add lemon blossoms, wisteria, or olive branches.
italian-romance.section_3_body: The villa arch and trailing garland layouts were designed for this style. They frame the monogram like a doorway into a garden.
italian-romance.section_4_body: Hand-painted invitations on cotton paper, menus with trailing floral corners, and welcome signs in gilded frames. This style is at home on a long table under the lemon trees.
italian-romance.faq_1_q: Is it only for Italian weddings?
italian-romance.faq_1_a: No. It works for any romantic venue — a French château, a Californian vineyard, a Provençal estate. The feeling is what matters.
italian-romance.faq_2_a: Lemon blossoms, wisteria, olive branches, jasmine, and white roses. The style rewards trailing, organic shapes over tight arrangements.
italian-romance.faq_3_a: The crest typography is set in English by default. If you want Italian wording, the simplest approach is to print the date and location in Italian on the invitation itself.

coastal.meta_description: Sea air, sandy beaches, and light coastal typography. Compose a coastal wedding crest.
coastal.heading: Coastal wedding crests
coastal.intro: Sea air, sandy beaches, and the kind of light that softens everything. The coastal style is the most relaxed — perfect for a beach wedding, a seaside estate, or a yacht club.
coastal.section_1_body: The coastal style is light, breezy, and quietly elegant. It feels like a long weekend by the sea — the kind of wedding you wear a linen suit to.
coastal.section_2_body: Coastal light typography, dusty blue and ivory palettes, and venues like beaches, yacht clubs, seaside estates, and clifftop hotels. Add sea oats, olive branches, or a single nautilus shell.
coastal.section_3_body: The wave arch and horizon layouts were designed for this style. They frame the monogram against an open horizon.
coastal.section_4_body: Letterpress invitations on cotton paper, menus with hand-drawn wave details, and welcome signs in weathered wood. This style is at home on a long table by the sea.
coastal.faq_1_a: Not at all. Pair it with a more formal typography pairing — modern serif or classic caps — and the result feels elegant without being stiff.
coastal.faq_2_a: A single shell, a sea oat, or the silhouette of your venue's coastline. Keep it to one touch for the cleanest result.
coastal.faq_3_q: Can I print it in navy?
coastal.faq_3_a: Yes. Unlock the Wedding Image Pack to download the original source-quality AI image without the preview watermark.
